title: RHCSA Rapid Track
subtitle: The complete RHCSA objectives on RHEL 10, for administrators who already use Linux
audience_line: Linux users and administrators preparing the RHCSA exam in one course
overview: This programme covers the RHCSA objectives on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 in one course, for participants who already work with Linux. A fast recap of the essentials leads to the system administration tasks the exam tests: networking and SSH, software, scheduling, scripting, firewalld, SELinux, partitions and LVM, NFS and autofs, permission troubleshooting and boot recovery. Rootless containers with Podman are taught as a RHEL skill outside the exam. Two timed mock EX200 exams measure readiness, and the programme closes with a final project: a full server build from a bare virtual machine against a written task list, in exam conditions.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: Linux users and administrators preparing the RHCSA exam in one course

facts.label: Prerequisites
facts.value: Working Linux experience: command line, files, users, permissions, services, vim; recapped quickly, not taught. Beginners take RHCSA Part 1: Red Hat System Administration I and RHCSA Part 2: Red Hat System Administration II instead

facts.label: Duration
facts.value: 48 h: 42 h of chapters + 6 h buffer

facts.label: Format
facts.value: Short lectures followed by guided labs on RHEL 10; two timed mock exams

facts.label: Lab environment
facts.value: Runs locally: one laptop per participant (16 GB RAM, hardware virtualization enabled) with two RHEL 10 virtual machines with spare virtual disks, built from the trainer’s images and registered with each participant’s no-cost Red Hat Developer Subscription for Individuals; no cloud account or cost

facts.label: Assessment
facts.value: A lab validated at the end of each phase, two timed mock EX200 exams and a final project graded against a task list; certificate of completion for participants who complete the labs and the project

facts.label: Outcome
facts.value: Participants can carry out the RHCSA objectives on RHEL 10 under timed conditions and are ready to sit the EX200 exam

phases.name: Core Administration
phases.focus: Essentials recap, system operation, networking and SSH
phases.intro: A fast recap of the command line, files and permissions brings the group to the same level, then participants operate the system: processes, tuning, services, logs and time, network configuration and key-based SSH. Validated lab: a server with users, permissions, a persistent journal, static networking and key-only SSH, built in a set time.

chapters.title: Essentials Recap
chapters.content: Command line, files, links, users, password ageing, permissions, special permissions, documentation

chapters.title: System Operation
chapters.content: Processes, process priorities (nice, renice), tuning profiles, services, logs and persistent journal, chrony

chapters.title: Networking & SSH
chapters.content: nmcli, IPv4 and IPv6, name resolution, key-based SSH, secure file transfer

phases.name: Software, Automation & Firewall
phases.focus: dnf and Flatpak, archives, scheduling, shell scripts, firewalld
phases.intro: Participants install software from repositories and Flatpak, archive files, schedule jobs with cron, at and systemd timers, write the short shell scripts the exam asks for, and open services through firewalld. Validated lab: a script scheduled by a systemd timer that archives a directory, and a service reachable through the firewall.

chapters.title: Software & Archives
chapters.content: dnf, RPM repositories, Flatpak, tar and compression

chapters.title: Shell Scripting
chapters.content: Conditionals, loops, script arguments, processing command output

phases.name: Security & Storage
phases.focus: SELinux, partitions and LVM, NFS and autofs, ACLs
phases.intro: Participants fix SELinux denials with contexts, booleans and port labels, build storage from raw disks with partitions, LVM and swap, mount network storage on demand, and solve permission problems with ACLs. Validated lab: an extended logical volume, automounted NFS home directories and a web service on a custom port with SELinux enforcing.

chapters.title: SELinux
chapters.content: Modes, contexts, booleans, port labels, troubleshooting

chapters.title: Storage
chapters.content: GPT partitions, LVM, extending volumes, swap, VFAT, ext4 and XFS, mounts by UUID

chapters.title: Permission Troubleshooting
chapters.content: Default permissions, diagnosing permission problems, ACLs

phases.name: Boot, Containers & Mock Exams
phases.focus: Boot recovery, Podman, two timed EX200 mock exams
phases.intro: Participants control boot targets and the bootloader and recover a lost root password, run rootless Podman containers as systemd services, then sit two timed mock EX200 exams, each followed by a debrief of the tasks that failed. Validated lab: a mock exam passed within the time limit.

chapters.title: Containers with Podman
chapters.content: Rootless containers, systemd integration (a RHEL skill, no longer in the RHCSA 10 exam)

chapters.title: Mock Exam 1
chapters.content: Timed EX200 mock exam on RHEL 10 and debrief of the failed tasks

chapters.title: Mock Exam 2
chapters.content: Second timed EX200 mock exam on a new task set and final debrief

phases.name: Final Project
phases.focus: A full RHCSA-style server build from a bare virtual machine
phases.intro: Each participant builds a server from a bare RHEL 10 virtual machine against a written task list, as in the exam, then checks and documents the result before it is graded.

chapters.title: Task List & Build
chapters.content: Work through the written task list on a bare RHEL 10 virtual machine: networking, users, storage, SELinux, firewall, scheduling, NFS

chapters.title: Verify & Document
chapters.content: Reboot test, self-check of every task, notes on the choices made

chapters.title: Grading & Review
chapters.content: Grading against the task list, review of failed tasks, plan for the exam

project.title: RHCSA-Style Server Build
project.brief: A bare RHEL 10 virtual machine turned into a working server from a written task list covering the RHCSA objectives, with every task still correct after a reboot.
project.stack: RHEL 10, Bash, systemd, NetworkManager, dnf, SELinux, LVM, XFS, NFS, autofs, firewalld
project.deliverable: Configured server, self-check notes, graded task list
